en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an old multi-story neoclassical building identified as 'Ivan Vazoff' Boys' Gymnasium in Stara Zagora, Bulgaria. The building is surrounded by trees, with several people standing or walking along the street in front. The reverse side is filled with handwritten text in Bulgarian, with printed text in both Bulgarian and French. There is also an official postal stamp from Stara Zagora.
